items.title: IFRS S1 Starter Kit
items.description: Most IFRS S1 templates tell you what to disclose, but not how to think about the disclosure. This Starter Kit takes a different approach — a fully worked, illustrative sustainability report built for a fictional professional services company, paired with plain-English explanations and practical prompts to help you build your own disclosures rather than copy someone else's.
includes: Introduction & User Guide (PDF) — how to use the kit, step by step
Sustainability Reporting Draft (Word) — an illustrative IFRS S1 report covering governance, strategy, risks & opportunities, and metrics & targets
Metrics & Targets Companion Workbook (Excel) — example metrics, activities and targets you can adapt
items.note: Built using Samyag Synergy Pte. Ltd. as a fictional illustrative example — not a real company's data or disclosures. For educational and informational use; not accounting, legal or professional advice.
